messages:
Priya: Quick idea — 12:15 stair-sprint + plyo microchallenge in the south stairwell? 15min, 6 rounds: up 3 flights fast, 10 squat jumps, down easy. Scale as needed, zero pressure.
Mark: Oof that sounds brutal but low time commitment. Is there a warmup?
Javier: I can run a 2min mobility warmup by the bike racks.
Nina: I left my trainers at home... anyone have a spare pair? :grimacing:
Zoe: Ive got a size 9 pair in office 4B. Also can bring a small towel.
Eric: Facilities just pinged me — stairwell maintenance test between 12:30-12:45 today. Might need to start earlier or move locations.
Priya: Good call. Let's start at 12:10 then? Or we can use the roof stairs if weathers fine.
Mark: Roof stairs ftw. If its raining, fallback to breakout C for a bodyweight circuit.
Javier: Plan: 12:10 warmup @bike racks -> stairs. I'll run the timer (15min box).
OpsBot: Reminder: Please keep stairwells clear for emergency egress. Follow facilities guidance.
Nina: Im in but going easy. Also, any quick snack recs post-workout?
Zoe: Banana + a handful of almonds. Coffee afterwards? :coffee:
Mark: Ill bring two electrolyte sachets.
Priya: Final list so far: Priya, Mark, Javier, Nina, Zoe, Eric. React with :thumbsup: to confirm. Post rounds completed here for bragging rights :trophy:.
Eric: :thumbsup:
Javier: :thumbsup:
Nina: :thumbsup:
Zoe: :thumbsup:
Mark: :thumbsup: (will post a sweaty selfie afterwards)
Priya: Sweet. See you at the bike racks in 10. Quick etiquette note: no muddy shoes on carpets and keep it short/quiet for the teams on calls. :pray:
